dish-photo-v1.promptTemplate:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: food card image for the Fandazi cooking app
Primary request: Create one finished serving of {{dishName}}. Show the defining ingredients accurately: {{keyIngredients}}. The finished dish should clearly look like {{dishName}}, prepared by {{cookMethod}}.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly transparent background; no table, no wall, no colored square, no gradient
Style/medium: refined hand-painted food illustration with realistic Chinese home-cooking texture, matching a warm watercolor cookbook illustration
Composition/framing: centered single ceramic plate or bowl, slight 30 to 45 degree overhead angle, generous transparent margin, food fully inside the square canvas
Lighting/mood: soft warm daylight, appetizing but natural
Constraints: one finished dish only; no people; no hands; no chopsticks; no text; no labels; no watermark; no restaurant logo; no collage; no visible square backdrop; no exaggerated garnish
Avoid: photorealistic camera noise, dark background, flat icon style, oversized plate cropped by canvas

ingredient-photo-v1.promptTemplate:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: ingredient image for the Fandazi cooking app
Primary request: Create a clear ingredient illustration of {{ingredientName}} in its normal household cooking form.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly transparent background; no table, no wall, no colored square, no gradient
Style/medium: refined hand-painted food illustration with realistic Chinese grocery texture, matching a warm watercolor cookbook illustration
Composition/framing: centered ingredient only, show a natural useful quantity, generous transparent margin, fully inside a square canvas
Lighting/mood: soft warm daylight, clean and appetizing
Constraints: no people; no hands; no text; no labels; no brand; no watermark; no price tag; no visible square backdrop
Avoid: dark background, flat icon style, collage, decorative typography
